name: openl-ai
description: Work with OpenL Studio from Claude Code — manage rules, projects, tables and tests over the OpenL MCP server.

studio_base_url.title: OpenL Studio address
studio_base_url.description: The address you open in your browser to use OpenL Studio, e.g. https://studio.example.com

studio_token.title: Personal Access Token (optional)
studio_token.description: Usually leave empty and sign in with /openl-ai:connect instead. Fill it only if your OpenL administrator gave you a token (created in Studio under User → Personal Access Tokens). Not needed for single-user Studio.

oauth_issuer.title: Sign-in service URL (optional, admin-provided)
oauth_issuer.description: Enables browser sign-in via /openl-ai:connect. Your OpenL administrator provides this value (the identity-provider issuer URL, e.g. https://idp.example.com/realms/openlstudio). Leave empty if you don't have it.

oauth_client_id.title: Sign-in client id (optional, admin-provided)
oauth_client_id.description: Leave empty unless your OpenL administrator gives you a value. Defaults to openl-cli.
